beats: Every photo we posted to Instagram was invisible to screen readers — and its hashtags were guesses, unrelated to the article.
The caption order shifted post to post too — no fixed spot for the link or the source.
Now the Instagram Graph API adds real alt text to every image.
And the hashtags come straight from the article's own tags, in one fixed order every time.
The formula lands eight to twelve hashtags — real ones, not guesses.
